en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an outdoor café terrace shaded by large trees. On the left, a building heavily covered in climbing plants borders the terrace, where flower boxes line a wooden railing. Several men in dark suits and hats, some with bow ties and one in a white waiter's jacket, stand or walk along the tree‑lined path. On the right are many empty tables and chairs stretching into the distance beside a riverside or park setting. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as a café in Graz.
